name: Haputale Tea Estate
description: The Haputale Tea Estate in the Badulla district is a prominent example of Sri Lanka's tea industry, showcasing the craftsmanship and heritage of tea cultivation. Established over a century ago by British colonialists, the estate now offers visitors a glimpse into its rich history through guided tours of its expansive tea plantations. The Cultural Museum provides insights into the evolution of the tea industry and its impact on local culture. Visitors can also enjoy picnics at scenic spots, immersing themselves in the tranquil beauty of the estate.
activities: Tea plantation tour, Cultural museum visit, Picnic at scenic spots

name: Dambatenne Tea Estate

A highlight for many is the photography opportunity amidst the verdant tea gardens, while others come to relax and savor the serene atmosphere. Cultural and historical significance aside, the estate remains a testament to the rich heritage of tea production in Sri Lanka.

name: Bandarawela Estate

name: Passara Tea Trail
description: Passara Tea Trail, nestled in the Badulla district of Sri Lanka, offers visitors a glimpse into the country's rich tea culture through guided tours and tea tasting experiences. The estate, established over a century ago, was once part of a larger plantation owned by the Ceylon Tea Traders Company. Today, it stands as a testament to the hard work and craftsmanship that went into cultivating these aromatic leaves. Visitors can explore the lush茶园, take part in a tea ceremony, and learn about the unique brewing techniques that make Passara teas so special.

name: Lunugala Garden
description: Lunugala Garden, nestled in the lush tea plantations of Badulla, offers visitors a glimpse into the world of Sri Lankan tea. name: Welimada Herb Walk
description: Welimada Herb Walk is a unique tea estate in Badulla, Sri Lanka, offering visitors an opportunity to explore its lush gardens while identifying local herbs. This site, known for its rich biodiversity, has been under the management of the Ceylon Tea Traders Association since 1925. Notable for its educational tours and talks, it also provides a glimpse into the traditional methods of tea cultivation and harvesting. Visitors can learn about the cultural and medicinal uses of various plants on the estate, making it a valuable stop for those interested in both tea culture and botany.
activities: Herb identification, Tea plantation tour, Educational talks

activities: Explore tea gardens, Visit tea factory, Learn about tea cultivation
